en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥

transliteration.english: ham sar dheen dhiaal na tum sar ab pateeaar kiaa keejai ||

en.bdb: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

verse.unicode: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: bachanee tor mor man maanai jan kau pooran dheejai ||1||

en.bdb: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥

transliteration.english: hau bal bal jaau ramieeaa kaarane ||

en.bdb: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.
O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥

transliteration.english: bahut janam bichhure the maadhau ih janam tum(h)aare lekhe ||

en.bdb: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

verse.unicode: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥

transliteration.english: keh ravidhaas aas lag jeevau chir bhio dharasan dhekhe ||2||1||

en.bdb: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||
